site_name: and adjacent caretakers lodge, Nicholay Road (site 2):
description:
Section 73 application for the variation of condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission P2020/0941/S73 dated 18 February 2022  P2018/2269/FUL dated 03/07/2018 (and subsequent amendment P2019/2083/NMA) for: The demolition of the sunken play pitch (site 1), community centre and adjacent caretaker's lodge (site 2) and the construction of a new community centre [282.42 sqm GIA] (site 2) and 46 new dwellings (private and affordable) in four blocks (sites 1 and 2) ranging in height from two to six storeys and associated amenity space, bicycle parking spaces and improvements to the public realm (including to Zoffany Park, site 3). Additionally, stopping up of an area of existing highway to the north and west of Duncombe Road and land immediately west of 158-178 St Johns Way under Section 247 of the Planning Act 1990 to enable redevelopment of Site 1.
The amendments include a change to the approved plans to reflect a change to the tenure of dwellings within the development to 100% affordable following the approval of P2026/0143/NMA.
